witness_description: The simple path v0-v1-v2-v3 with M1={(v0,v1),(v2,v3)} and M2={(v1,v2)}. Its edge labels alternate M1,M2,M1.
refutation_explanation: Both M1 edges are in an alternating path, so the claimed left side is 2, while |M2| is 1. Thus 2 <= 1 is false, even though this component satisfies the stated componentwise bound 2 <= 1+1.
search_space: All 14 single connected labeled constructions consisting of a simple alternating path with 2 through 6 edges and either initial label, or a simple alternating cycle with 4 or 6 edges and either initial label; every construction was checked.
